scope: Noncommercial historical research; no new competition submission or accuracy claim

claims.title: Historical public scores
claims.detail: Own pipeline 0.309; fusion 0.422 includes the external v4n solution. These are archived author logs, not a fresh leaderboard readback or final private scores.

claims.title: Source-library composition
claims.detail: 2,539,608 spectra and 275,810 structure keys in the committed profile. Counts are not an independent audit of the current source dataset.

claims.title: Same-library C1 exclusion
claims.detail: Code excludes complete same-library reference groups, including unsampled equivalent-structure spectra. Synthetic regressions exist; historical scores were not recomputed.

claims.title: Fixed-grid simultaneous uncertainty
claims.detail: Paired bootstrap bands account for a predeclared novelty-mixture grid. Repeated model selection and domain shift remain outside that guarantee.

claims.title: Full corrected-protocol revalidation
claims.detail: Requires licensed data, immutable input hashes, verified fingerprints, fresh analog indices and paired per-molecule outputs. No completed full-data rerun is asserted.

claims.title: Exact train / public-example overlap
claims.detail: The archived 1,213 coarse-key matches are insufficient to establish exact peak-and-intensity identity. Recompute content-level overlap before claiming complete leakage.
